name: Path Dimension / co-VC Dimension (Incomparable)
details: Neither parameter has a universal affine-linear upper bound in terms of the other, even for finite classes.
parameter_1_larger_witness: For half-intervals $\mathcal I_n$, $\mathrm P(\mathcal I_n)=n-1$ while $\operatorname{coVC}(\mathcal I_n)=2$.
parameter_2_larger_witness: For the singleton class $\mathcal S_n$, $\operatorname{coVC}(\mathcal S_n)=n$ while $\mathrm P(\mathcal S_n)=1$.
proof: The canonical value calculations give the two opposite unbounded separations.
proof_source: Database-owned value proofs for Path Dimension and co-VC Dimension of Half-intervals and Singletons.
